criteria.given: Retired Codex runtime role and pool pins
criteria.when: Current official guidance and local advertised models are reviewed and sync runs
then: Codex defaults use Sol for thinking, Luna for scoped typing/cheap review, and Astra for challenge/high-risk review; picker contains all three current models
criteria.reason: Nonbehavioral model configuration; existing generation behavior is unchanged

criteria.given: Existing portable stage roles, other runtimes and override precedence
criteria.when: Codex pins and the existing shell test expectation change
then: Other runtime assignments and override semantics remain intact; existing sync regression check passes
criteria.reason: Nonbehavioral configuration and expected-output update; repository CheckPlan still executes

criteria.given: Tasks differ in complexity and budget
criteria.when: A developer selects a model for a bounded or complex workstream
then: Guidance keeps simple execution on Luna and shows existing workstream overrides for complex Sol/Astra work without altering risk rules
criteria.reason: Documentation of existing model override behavior; no new classifier or execution behavior

criteria.given: Current Codex task-fit defaults and optional effort overlays
criteria.when: The runtime-agent generator resolves and emits all stage assignments
then: Known models receive medium effort except Astra high and Verify low; HIGH/CRITICAL Review follows Astra high
Explicit ASK_EFFORT environment wins over workstream then consumer settings; explicit inherit and unknown-model fallback omit the effort field
Invalid effort values fail before any generated outputs change; other runtime outputs and model precedence are unchanged
